rows.note: the jit envelope: wall time per call. It equals the two compute ops' sum exactly, which says every copy hid behind compute.
the discovery: XLA:TPU pattern-matched the softmax and second matmul into its own online-softmax kernel, one pass over S, tiled 1024x1024. A custom call: cost models cannot see inside it.
an async copy per iteration, 40 events for 20 iterations because start and its span both appear. Its 89.6 µs is the in-flight window riding under the fusion, not time added to the program.
QK^T computed and the full bf16[8192,8192] written to HBM: the spill's first half, 134 MB per iteration, hardware-timed.
the cheap operand copy: issued and done almost instantly; compare its span with copy-start.1's.
the wait end of an async copy: nearly free when the transfer already landed. This pairing is the same start/wait transaction chapter 06 teaches with semaphores.
the wait for the long copy: still nearly free, because the 89.6 µs transfer finished while the fusion computed.
